from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section1Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout (Title and Lecture Notes)
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        title_text = "The Triangle of Power: Unified Notation"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- Connects Powers, Roots, and Logs",
            "- Visual representation of $x^y = z$",
            "- High mathematical symmetry",
            "- Simplified algebraic manipulation"
        ]

        title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(title)

        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        lecture_group = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        lecture_group.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture_group, shift=RIGHT))
